question: how hard does the switch node ring with this layout?

plan.question: how hard does the switch node ring with this layout?

reasons.decided: buck_tight.kicad_pcb is a .kicad_pcb file, read as a board (kicad)

steps.headline: buck_tight.kicad_pcb has 5 routed nets on 2 layers, with trace impedances from 60.2 to 113 ohm. The longest, VIN, runs 21.7 mm with 7.87 nH, 2.17 pF and 5.33 mohm. The worst crosstalk is 0.1% between G and GND over 0.6 mm at a 1 ns edge. In buck.cir the layout raises the peak across D1 from 13.2 V on the schematic alone to 31.3 V, ringing at 79.4 MHz.
